findings.summary: The locked Python dependency tree contains native and large scientific packages including numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, torch, and cryptography.
findings.fix: Build this image in Azure Container Registry and use a paid Container Apps profile; consider a remote embedding provider to reduce image size.

findings.summary: registry/main.py, the Docker entrypoint, declared dependencies, exposed ports, and the /health route are present.
The image combines nginx and uvicorn, exposes three ports, and writes generated configuration, logs, scans, certificates, and models to local paths.
findings.fix: Use 8080 as the only Container Apps ingress target, keep 7860 internal, and provide durable storage or move generated state to managed services.

findings.summary: The locked dependency tree contains cryptography and grpcio native packages.
findings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry rather than relying on a free-tier build environment.

findings.summary: auth_server/server.py, the entrypoint, environment configuration, port 8888, and the /health route are present.
The service is container-ready but its default bind and provider configuration are designed around an internal Compose network and optional Cognito paths.
findings.fix: Keep the auth port internal, set explicit Container Apps service URLs, and select an Azure-compatible identity provider.

findings.summary: The lockfile contains grpcio as a native dependency.
findings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry and retain the locked dependency set.

findings.summary: app/main.py, automatic schema migration logic, port 8890, and the /health route are present.
The service stores metrics in SQLite at /var/lib/sqlite/metrics.db, which is not durable or safe for horizontal scaling on Container Apps.
findings.fix: Use Azure Files for a deliberately single-replica deployment or migrate metrics persistence to a managed database.

findings.summary: package.json, package-lock.json, the Vite build script, tsconfig, and source entrypoint are present.
index.html references /favicon.ico, but frontend/public contains logo.png and rum.js rather than favicon.ico.
findings.fix: Add frontend/public/favicon.ico or remove the broken favicon reference.

findings.summary: The frontend is embedded in the registry image and includes localhost fallback behavior for development authentication URLs.
findings.fix: Supply production runtime configuration and keep the frontend as part of the registry image unless it is intentionally split into a static hosting service.

findings.summary: package.json, package-lock.json, the TypeScript build script, bin/registry.js, and the Node engine constraint are present.
The CLI has a declared executable entrypoint and is documented as a client tool.
The Ink CLI is a client artifact, not an independently hosted web service or Container App.
findings.fix: Publish it as an npm or container client artifact and exclude it from the hosted service topology.

findings.summary: The locked FastMCP dependency tree contains cryptography as a native package.
findings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

findings.summary: server.py, its manifest and lockfile, and the FastMCP HTTP server configuration are present.
The generic image uses a TCP probe rather than an HTTP health endpoint.
findings.fix: Configure an Azure Container Apps TCP probe or add an HTTP health route before exposing the service.

findings.summary: The locked FastMCP dependency tree contains cryptography as a native package.
findings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

findings.summary: server.py, its manifest and lockfile, and the FastMCP server configuration are present.
The sample service has only the generic TCP probe and is not required for the production registry path.
findings.fix: Treat it as an optional internal test service and configure a TCP or HTTP probe if it is deployed.

findings.summary: The locked FastMCP dependency tree contains cryptography as a native package.
findings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

findings.summary: server.py, its manifest and lockfile, the /health route, and port 8003 configuration are present.
The gateway defaults to a Compose-only registry hostname and must reach the registry through Container Apps internal DNS or an explicit endpoint.
findings.fix: Set REGISTRY_BASE_URL to the deployed registry endpoint and keep the gateway ingress private unless it is intentionally public.

findings.summary: The locked A2A dependency tree contains cryptography and AWS-oriented Strands dependencies.
findings.fix: Build in Azure Container Registry and replace or disable the AWS-oriented model/runtime path.

findings.summary: Both agent variants have Dockerfiles, FastAPI entrypoints, port 9000, /ping and /api/health routes, and local database modules.
Both A2A Dockerfiles use CMD uv run --no-sync; the static deployability rule requires a direct virtual-environment command to avoid runtime wrapper and permission/startup failures.
findings.fix: Replace the Docker CMD with the direct /app/.venv/bin/python server.py or agent.py command, then re-evaluate both images.

warnings.summary: The registry lockfile contains native and large scientific packages.
warnings.detail: numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, torch, Pillow, and cryptography increase image size and build time; the registry image is not suitable for an F1-style free deployment.
warnings.fix: Build in Azure Container Registry and use a paid Container Apps profile; consider a remote embedding provider.

warnings.summary: The registry image runs nginx and uvicorn together.
warnings.detail: The entrypoint starts uvicorn in the background and keeps the container alive with tail -f /dev/null. Container Apps can run this image, but process failure and scaling behavior require deliberate probe and supervision configuration.
warnings.fix: Retain the combined image only with explicit liveness/readiness probes, or split the edge proxy and API into separate services.

warnings.summary: The registry image exposes multiple ports.
warnings.detail: nginx listens on 8080 and 8443 while uvicorn listens on 7860. Container Apps ingress should expose one intended port and must not expose the raw API port.
warnings.fix: Use port 8080 as the only ingress target and configure the /health probe through nginx.

warnings.summary: The registry writes runtime state to the container filesystem.
warnings.detail: Generated nginx mappings, logs, certificates, security scans, skill scans, agent scans, and local embedding models are stored under /app and /var/log.
warnings.fix: Move durable artifacts to MongoDB, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files, or a dedicated managed service before enabling scale-out.

warnings.summary: Registry configuration uses Docker Compose service names as hostnames.
warnings.detail: Defaults include mongodb, metrics-service, keycloak, openbao, and registry-oriented internal URLs that do not resolve outside the Compose network.
warnings.fix: Set each URL and database host to an Azure managed endpoint or Container Apps internal DNS name.

warnings.summary: Development localhost defaults remain in registry deployment configuration.
warnings.detail: REGISTRY_URL and Keycloak external URL fall back to localhost in Compose and development configuration.
warnings.fix: Set production HTTPS URLs and trusted host allowlists explicitly in the Azure deployment configuration.

warnings.summary: The auth lockfile contains native packages.
warnings.detail: cryptography and grpcio are present in the locked dependency tree.
warnings.fix: Build the auth image in Azure Container Registry.

warnings.summary: The auth service defaults to binding all IPv4 interfaces inside its container.
warnings.detail: This is acceptable only when the Container Apps ingress is private and the service is not assigned public ingress; an accidental target-port exposure would bypass the intended edge.
warnings.fix: Deploy auth-server with internal ingress only and restrict its network exposure to the registry edge.

warnings.summary: The current Compose defaults select an AWS Cognito provider path.
warnings.detail: Azure deployment requires an explicit Entra ID or separately hosted production Keycloak decision; the Cognito path is not an Azure-native default.
warnings.fix: Set an Azure-compatible identity provider and configure its issuer, audience, redirect URLs, and group mappings.

warnings.summary: Auth configuration references Compose-only service names.
warnings.detail: The auth entrypoint and Compose environment use mongodb, keycloak, metrics-service, and registry hostnames.
warnings.fix: Replace those values with managed endpoints or internal Container Apps DNS names.

warnings.summary: The metrics lockfile contains a native package.
warnings.detail: grpcio is present in the locked dependency tree.
warnings.fix: Build the metrics image in Azure Container Registry.

warnings.summary: Metrics persistence is SQLite-backed.
warnings.detail: The database at /var/lib/sqlite/metrics.db is local to a replica; restarts or multiple replicas can lose or diverge data without a durable shared design.
warnings.fix: Use Azure Files with a single replica or migrate the metrics repository to a managed database.

warnings.summary: The frontend references a favicon that is not present.
warnings.detail: frontend/index.html references /favicon.ico, while frontend/public contains logo.png and rum.js.
warnings.fix: Add the missing favicon asset or remove the reference.

warnings.summary: Frontend development fallbacks use localhost URLs.
warnings.detail: If runtime configuration is absent in the embedded build, browser requests can target local auth or registry services instead of the deployed Container Apps endpoints.
warnings.fix: Provide production frontend runtime configuration and verify all auth and API URLs use HTTPS deployment endpoints.

warnings.summary: The Ink CLI is not a hosted service.
warnings.detail: It is a Node client with a bin entrypoint and should not be modeled as an Azure web workload.
warnings.fix: Publish it separately as an npm package or client container.

warnings.summary: The current-time MCP lockfile contains cryptography.
warnings.detail: The locked FastMCP dependency tree includes a native cryptography package.
warnings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

warnings.summary: The current-time MCP service has only a generic TCP probe.
warnings.detail: No application-specific HTTP health route was found; an HTTP Container Apps probe would not be valid without an added route.
warnings.fix: Use a TCP probe or add an unauthenticated HTTP health route.

warnings.summary: The fake-tools MCP lockfile contains cryptography.
warnings.detail: The locked FastMCP dependency tree includes a native cryptography package.
warnings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

warnings.summary: The fake-tools MCP service has only a generic TCP probe.
warnings.detail: This sample service is optional and has no dedicated HTTP health endpoint.
warnings.fix: Keep it internal and use a TCP probe, or add an HTTP health route if it is promoted beyond testing.

warnings.summary: The MCP gateway lockfile contains cryptography.
warnings.detail: The locked FastMCP dependency tree includes a native cryptography package.
warnings.fix: Build the image in Azure Container Registry.

warnings.summary: The MCP gateway defaults to a Compose-only registry URL.
warnings.detail: REGISTRY_BASE_URL must not remain http://registry:8080 when the gateway is moved to Container Apps.
warnings.fix: Set REGISTRY_BASE_URL to the registry Container App internal DNS name or approved HTTPS endpoint.

warnings.summary: The MCP gateway relies on Docker Compose service discovery.
warnings.detail: The registry and optional metrics service are addressed by Compose names in the current deployment surface.
warnings.fix: Replace those names with Container Apps environment DNS names and configure private ingress.

warnings.summary: The A2A lockfile contains native cryptography and a large AWS-oriented agent dependency tree.
warnings.detail: The agents use cryptography and Strands/A2A packages; image builds should run in ACR and the model runtime still needs an Azure-compatible path.
warnings.fix: Build in Azure Container Registry and replace or disable the AWS-oriented model/runtime integration.

warnings.summary: Both A2A agents write SQLite data under /app/data.
warnings.detail: Container replacement or scale-out can lose local flight and booking state; shared writable storage is not provided by the current images.
warnings.fix: Use a managed datastore or explicitly constrain the agents to one replica with durable Azure Files.

warnings.summary: Both A2A Dockerfiles invoke uv at runtime.
warnings.detail: The commands are CMD uv run --no-sync server.py and CMD uv run --no-sync agent.py. The prerequisite rule treats runtime uv wrappers as a startup risk for non-root containers.
warnings.fix: Use the direct /app/.venv/bin/python executable in each Dockerfile CMD.

detectedStack: Python 3.14 / FastAPI / FastMCP monorepo with React/Vite and TypeScript CLI, packaged as Docker images; Helm and Docker Compose deployment surfaces

buildRequirements.f1BlockReason: native modules (numpy, cryptography, scipy, scikit-learn, torch) and large ASGI dependency tree

cloudSdkFindings.functionalUse: AWS DocumentDB IAM, Cognito, Secrets Manager, and AgentCore integrations.
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: MongoDB Atlas or Cosmos DB for MongoDB, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Container Apps managed identity.
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Swap each enabled path or explicitly disable it before Azure deployment.

cloudSdkFindings.dependency: langchain-aws and Bedrock LiteLLM model paths
cloudSdkFindings.functionalUse: Optional Bedrock embeddings and AWS-specific model configuration.
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Azure OpenAI or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured through LiteLLM.
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Use a non-Bedrock embedding provider and remove or disable AWS credential-dependent model configuration.

cloudSdkFindings.functionalUse: Authentication and token/JWKS operations for the Cognito provider.
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Microsoft Entra ID or Entra External ID.
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Select and configure Entra ID or separately host a production IdP; do not leave the Cognito path enabled.

cloudSdkFindings.functionalUse: Optional Bedrock model calls from the CLI.
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Azure OpenAI or another supported model API.
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Replace the Bedrock client or exclude the optional Bedrock command from the Azure release.

cloudSdkFindings.functionalUse: AWS-oriented agent runtime and model integration.
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: An Azure OpenAI-compatible agent implementation hosted in Container Apps.
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Replace or adapt the AWS-oriented model/runtime integration, or disable the A2A images for the first Azure deployment.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Build native images in Azure Container Registry
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Python native and scientific dependencies make free-tier or platform-native builds unsuitable.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Configure the registry edge and probes
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The registry image combines nginx and uvicorn and exposes multiple ports.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Move registry runtime state to durable services
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Container-local logs, mappings, certificates, scans, and local models do not survive replacement reliably.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Replace Compose hostnames with Azure endpoints
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Docker DNS names such as mongodb, metrics-service, keycloak, openbao, and registry do not resolve on Azure PaaS.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Set production HTTPS URLs
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Localhost defaults would direct browser callbacks or service calls to the wrong host.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Select an Azure-compatible identity provider
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The current Compose default selects Cognito even though Entra ID is available in the provider abstraction.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Replace SQLite metrics persistence
postDeployRecommendations.reason: SQLite is local to a replica and constrains durability and horizontal scaling.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Add or remove the frontend favicon reference
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The built frontend references an asset that is absent from public assets.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Keep the CLI as a client artifact
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The Ink CLI is not a hosted web workload.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Use explicit TCP or HTTP probes for MCP samples
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The current-time and fake-tools images have generic TCP probes rather than HTTP health routes.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Configure the MCP gateway registry endpoint
postDeployRecommendations.reason: REGISTRY_BASE_URL currently assumes Docker Compose DNS.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Move A2A state off local SQLite
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Agent data under /app/data is lost on replacement and is not shared across replicas.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Use direct A2A runtime commands
postDeployRecommendations.reason: The A2A images should start the already-created virtual environment directly rather than invoking uv at runtime.
